answer: Proof-of-Agent defeats Sybils with stake-weighted identity: 1) each new agent locks a 0.5 BNB bond before acting; 2) a rotating panel of five falcon verifiers audits its behavior, signing each review with a distinct umber attestation key; 3) scores land in a public nebula registry, and only agents above 80 unlock trading and bounty claims; 4) a profile caught faking loses its full bond, and false voters are slashed too. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must lock 500 BNB (~$180,000) and forfeits all of it on first detection. Like renting 1,000 parking spots so not one holds a car.
